name: codex-code-explain
description: Explain selected code with Codex using nearby context and available definitions. Ask follow-up questions and save Markdown notes.

codexExplain.notesPath.markdownDescription: Absolute path to a Markdown note file, or a path relative to the current code workspace, such as `notes/code-explanations.md`. If empty, the first save opens a file picker. Notes are appended, never overwritten.

codexExplain.codexPath.description: Path to the native Codex executable. If empty, searches PATH, Codex desktop, and the official VS Code extension.

codexExplain.contextLines.description: Number of code lines included before and after the selection.

codexExplain.maxContextCharacters.description: Maximum combined characters for the selection, nearby code, and language-service results. Truncation is marked explicitly.
